thread:
lina: Thanks everyone 94 follow-up from today's all-hands on pricing/packaging/usage policy. Putting notes and open items here.
sam: First Q: what's the lifecycle for free trial credits? Do they auto-renew or expire?
maya: Second Q: are there per-minute burst caps separate from per-second soft limits on hosted API?
ethan: For Dedicated customers, does burst capacity get billed differently than committed capacity? Any hard upper limits to bursts?
ops-bot: deploy-notice: SDK rate-limit headers added to responses in canary.
julia: Legal: credits are granted under promo-specific terms; default is 12 months expiry, non-transferable. We'll add explicit language to billing TOS.
lina: Confirmed: default expiry is 12 months from issuance unless promo notes otherwise. They don't roll over month-to-month.
sam: Can we add that to the public billing FAQ? Trials ask frequently.
lina: Yes 94 action assigned to finance/docs.
maya: Rate limits: hosted default soft limit is ~10 rps (600 rpm) per project; we return `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Reset` headers. We also have a short queue grace period before 429s.
ethan: SDKs (python/js) will expose these headers and backoff helpers this week.
tim: Sales note: Dedicated contracts can include a negotiated prepaid burst pool as an add-on; pricing varies by GPU family and region.
maya: For noisy or unpredictable workloads, can we auto-suggest Dedicated? I want to avoid pushing recommendations that upset customers.
sam: Ops is prototyping a 'soft throttle' with 60s queue grace then 429; finance will propose defaults.
lina: Ops, can grace be configurable per org? Some customers want immediate errors; others prefer queuing.
ops-bot: ticket created: ORG-729 request for per-org throttle-grace setting.
devex: I'll create a "When to escalate" playbook with cURL and header examples and troubleshooting steps (example threshold values included). Draft by EOD Friday.
maya: Also: do credits cover marketplace add-ons?
julia: Not by default. Credits apply to API usage; exceptions must be specified in a promo. We'll update the FAQ.

lina: Thanks. I'll synthesize this into the all-hands follow-up doc and post to #docs. If anyone else has items, add them here.
